GOAL: ready-to-integrate Docker recipes to add **Factorio** and **Garry's Mod** as Dockerized game servers on Nxeon. Each game = a Docker container via a maintained community image, installed by a one-line setupScript. EXACT existing pattern:
- `curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && docker run -d --name mc -e EULA=TRUE -p 25565:25565 -v /opt/mc:/data --restart unless-stopped itzg/minecraft-server`

For EACH game, find the BEST-MAINTAINED working Docker image (verify Docker Hub/GitHub 2026; Factorio: factoriotools/factorio is the standard; GMod: look for a maintained one — e.g. ich777/gameserver variants or another). Produce, per game:
1. **Docker image** + why + verified URL.
2. **setupScript** — exact `curl … | sh && docker run -d --name <factorio|gmod> … <image>` with correct ports (Factorio 34197/udp; GMod 27015/tcp+udp, 27005/udp), volume `-v /opt/<name>:<container path>`, sane env. GMod needs a GSLT token env for public listing (use a placeholder `__GSLT__`).
3. **Ports to forward**.
4. **game-control**: container name, on-host config file path (Factorio: server-settings.json + saves under the volume; GMod: garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg), restart = `docker restart <name>`.
5. **game-config FamilySchema** — a TS object using this EXACT shape (IMPORTANT — use these literal types): `{ family, label, defaultVariant, variants:[{id,label,description}], fields:[{ key, label, group, type:"int"|"bool"|"enum"|"string", default, options?:[{value,label}], min?, max?, phase:"deploy"|"live", help? }] }`. Factorio variants: stable vs experimental (or Space Age on/off). GMod variants: gamemodes (sandbox/darkrp/ttt/prophunt). ~5 real fields each.
6. **GamePlan tiers**: `[{ name, ramMB, cpuCores, diskGB, slots, priceCents, featured? }]`. Factorio is LIGHT (2-4GB, cheap); GMod modest (2-6GB).
7. **GAME_META**: `{ name, tag }`.

Concrete, verify images are real & maintained. Write it all as your final message.

# Factorio Server Docker Image Status

**Current Status & Update:**
- Latest version: `2.0.76`
- Last updated: 9 days ago
- 10M+ pulls, 228 stars

**Available Tags:**
- `latest, 2.0.76` (most current)
- `stable` (declared stable on factorio.com)
- Version-specific tags (e.g., `0.x.y`, `0.x-z`)
- Rootless variants with `-rootless` suffix

**Recommended Docker Run Command:**
```bash
sudo docker run -d \
  -p 34197:34197/udp \
  -p 27015:27015/tcp \
  -v /opt/factorio:/factorio \
  --name factorio \
  --restart=unless-stopped \
  factoriotools/factorio
```

**Key Ports:**
- `34197/udp` – Game server (adjustable via `PORT` variable)
- `27015/tcp` – RCON (optional)

**Essential Volume:**
- `-v /opt/factorio:/factorio` – Single volume for config, mods, and saves

**Important Environment Variables:**
- `GENERATE_NEW_SAVE` – Create new map if none exists
- `LOAD_LATEST_SAVE` – Auto-load newest save
- `SAVE_NAME` – Specify which save to load
- `UPDATE_MODS_ON_START` – Auto-update mods on startup

**Pre-run Setup:**
```bash
sudo mkdir -p /opt/factorio
sudo chown 845:845 /opt/factorio
```

# jcivitell/garrysmod Docker Image Summary

**Environment Variables:**
- `GM_SERVERNAME` - Server name display
- `GM_GAMEMODE` - Game mode (default: "terrortown")
- `GM_MAP` - Starting map selection
- `GM_STEAMTOKEN` - GSLT authentication key
- `GM_PORT` - Port configuration (27015)
- `GM_PW` - Server password
- `GM_MAXPLAYERS` - Player limit (10)
- `GM_WORKSHOP` - Workshop collection loader
- `GM_LOCATION` - Country flag

**Volume Path:** `/home/steam/gm-dedicated/`

```bash
mkdir -p $(pwd)/gm-data && chmod 777 $(pwd)/gm-data
docker run -d --net=host \
  -v $(pwd)/gm-data:/home/steam/gm-dedicated/ \
  --name=gm-dedicated jcivitell/garrysmod
```

- `GAME_ID`: 4020

- `GAME_PARAMS`: "-secure +maxplayers 12 +map gm_flatgrass"
- `GAME_PORT`: 27015
- `USERNAME`: (blank - for Steam credentials if needed)
- `PASSWRD`: (blank - for Steam credentials if needed)
- `VALIDATE`: (blank - set to 'true' to validate installation)
- `UID`: 99
- `GID`: 100

**Note:** No GSLT token variable is present in this configuration.

## Volume Paths
- **SteamCMD:** `/mnt/user/appdata/steamcmd` → `/serverdata/steamcmd`
- **Game Data:** `/mnt/cache/appdata/garrysmod` → `/serverdata/serverfiles`

## Exposed Ports
- **UDP:** 27015 (game port)
- **TCP:** 27015 (RCON port)

# Factorio

## 1. Docker image
- **`factoriotools/factorio`** (Docker Hub) — this is the de-facto standard Factorio server image. Actively maintained (last push ~9 days ago, tracking game v2.0.76), 10M+ pulls, single-volume design, auto save-management env vars.

- Tags: `stable` (game-declared stable), `latest`/experimental, plus `-rootless` variants. Runs as UID/GID **845**.

## 2. setupScript
```bash
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && mkdir -p /opt/factorio && chown 845:845 /opt/factorio && docker run -d --name factorio -e GENERATE_NEW_SAVE=true -e LOAD_LATEST_SAVE=true -e SAVE_NAME=nxeon -p 34197:34197/udp -p 27015:27015/tcp -v /opt/factorio:/factorio --restart unless-stopped factoriotools/factorio:stable
```
(Swap the `:stable` tag for `:latest` for the experimental variant.)

## 3. Ports to forward
- **34197/udp** — game (required)
- **27015/tcp** — RCON (optional; only if remote console is exposed)

## 4. game-control
- Container name: **`factorio`**
- On-host config (under the `/opt/factorio` volume, which mounts to `/factorio` in-container):
  - Server settings: `/opt/factorio/config/server-settings.json`
  - Saves: `/opt/factorio/saves/` (`*.zip`)
  - Mods: `/opt/factorio/mods/`
  - Admins/banlist/whitelist: `/opt/factorio/config/server-adminlist.json`, etc.
- Restart: `docker restart factorio`

# Garry's Mod

## 1. Docker image
- **`ghcr.io/ich777/steamcmd:garrysmod`** — from ich777, the most active gameserver-Docker maintainer (the Unraid gameserver-template ecosystem). The `docker-steamcmd-server` base pulls/validates the GMod Dedicated Server (Steam app **4020**) via SteamCMD on every start, so it self-updates. Preferred over the alternatives: `jcivitell/garrysmod` (last updated ~2 yrs ago) and `lacledeslan/gamesvr-garrysmod` (LAN-party focused, no simple GSLT one-liner).
- Verified: https://hub.docker.com/r/ich777/steamcmd (tag `garrysmod`) — template/source: https://github.com/ich777/docker-steamcmd-server and https://github.com/ich777/docker-templates/blob/master/ich777/GarrysMod.xml
- Runs as UID **99** / GID **100** by default.

## 2. setupScript
GMod passes all launch options (incl. the GSLT) through the single `GAME_PARAMS` env var; `+sv_setsteamaccount` carries the GSLT token needed for public listing:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && mkdir -p /opt/gmod && docker run -d --name gmod -e GAME_PARAMS="-secure +gamemode sandbox +map gm_construct +maxplayers 16 +sv_setsteamaccount __GSLT__" -e VALIDATE=true -p 27015:27015/tcp -p 27015:27015/udp -p 27005:27005/udp -v /opt/gmod:/serverdata/serverfiles --restart unless-stopped ghcr.io/ich777/steamcmd:garrysmod
```
- `__GSLT__` = placeholder for the customer's Game Server Login Token from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (app 4020).
- If you want the SteamCMD binaries on a separate mount, also add `-v /opt/gmod-steamcmd:/serverdata/steamcmd` (optional).

## 3. Ports to forward
- **27015/tcp** and **27015/udp** — game + RCON
- **27005/udp** — client/source traffic
- (optional) **27020/udp** — SourceTV, only if enabled

## 4. game-control
- Container name: **`gmod`**
- On-host config (under `/opt/gmod`, which mounts to `/serverdata/serverfiles` in-container):
  - Main server config: `/opt/gmod/garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg`
  - Addons: `/opt/gmod/garrysmod/addons/`
  - Maps: `/opt/gmod/garrysmod/maps/`
  - Data/saves: `/opt/gmod/garrysmod/data/`
- Restart: `docker restart gmod`
- Note: launch-time settings (gamemode, map, GSLT, maxplayers) live in the container's `GAME_PARAMS` env, not `server.cfg`; changing a variant/those fields requires recreating the container, while `server.cfg` values (hostname, rcon, sv_password) hot-reload on restart.

## 5. game-config FamilySchema
```ts
const gmodFamily = {
  family: "gmod",
  label: "Garry's Mod",
  defaultVariant: "sandbox",
  variants: [
    { id: "sandbox",  label: "Sandbox",      description: "Classic build/tinker sandbox — the default Garry's Mod experience." },
    { id: "darkrp",   label: "DarkRP",       description: "Roleplay economy gamemode (jobs, money, base-building)." },
    { id: "terrortown", label: "TTT",        description: "Trouble in Terrorist Town — social-deduction rounds." },
    { id: "prop_hunt", label: "Prop Hunt",   description: "Hide-as-props vs. hunters." },
  ],
  fields: [
    { key: "hostname",      label: "Server name",     group: "General",  type: "string", default: "Nxeon Garry's Mod", phase: "live",   help: "Shown in the server browser (writes hostname to server.cfg)." },
    { key: "max_players",   label: "Max players",     group: "General",  type: "int",    default: 16, min: 2, max: 128, phase: "deploy" },
    { key: "default_map",   label: "Starting map",    group: "General",  type: "enum",   default: "gm_construct",       phase: "deploy",
      options: [
        { value: "gm_construct", label: "gm_construct" },
        { value: "gm_flatgrass", label: "gm_flatgrass" },
        { value: "rp_downtown_v4c_v2", label: "rp_downtown (DarkRP)" },
        { value: "ttt_minecraft_b5", label: "ttt_minecraft (TTT)" },
      ] },
    { key: "sv_password",   label: "Server password", group: "Access",   type: "string", default: "",                   phase: "live",   help: "Leave blank for an open server." },
    { key: "gslt_token",    label: "GSLT token",      group: "Access",   type: "string", default: "__GSLT__",           phase: "deploy", help: "Steam Game Server Login Token (app 4020) required for public listing." },
    { key: "workshop_collection", label: "Workshop collection ID", group: "Content", type: "string", default: "", phase: "deploy", help: "Steam Workshop collection ID to auto-mount addons." },
  ],
};
```

## 6. GamePlan tiers (GMod modest)
```ts
const gmodPlans = [
  { name: "Starter",  ramMB: 2048, cpuCores: 1, diskGB: 15, slots: 12, priceCents: 399 },
  { name: "Standard", ramMB: 4096, cpuCores: 2, diskGB: 30, slots: 24, priceCents: 799, featured: true },
  { name: "Pro",      ramMB: 6144, cpuCores: 3, diskGB: 50, slots: 64, priceCents: 1399 },
];
```

## 7. GAME_META
```ts
const gmodMeta = { name: "Garry's Mod", tag: "gmod" };
```

---

## Integration notes / caveats
- Both `setupScript`s follow the exact Minecraft pattern: `curl … | sh && … docker run -d --name … --restart unless-stopped <image>`. I added `mkdir -p`/`chown` in the chain because both images need the host volume dir to exist first (Factorio also needs `chown 845:845`).
- **GSLT is a per-customer secret.** The `__GSLT__` placeholder must be substituted at deploy time (env injection) before the GMod container is created — an unset/invalid token means the server won't appear in the public browser. For GMod it lives inside `GAME_PARAMS`, so game-config should template that whole string rather than pass a bare env var.
- **Variant switching differs by game:** Factorio variants are just image tags (`:stable` / `:latest`), swapped by recreating the container. GMod variants change `+gamemode`/`+map` inside `GAME_PARAMS`, also requiring container recreation — mark those fields `phase: "deploy"` (already done).
- First GMod boot is slow: SteamCMD downloads the full server (~2-4 GB) into the volume; keep `VALIDATE=true` for the first run, optionally drop it afterward to speed restarts.

Sources: [factoriotools/factorio](https://hub.docker.com/r/factoriotools/factorio), [ich777/steamcmd](https://hub.docker.com/r/ich777/steamcmd), [ich777 GarrysMod template](https://github.com/ich777/docker-templates/blob/master/ich777/GarrysMod.xml), [ich777 docker-steamcmd-server](https://github.com/ich777/docker-steamcmd-server), [jcivitell/garrysmod](https://hub.docker.com/r/jcivitell/garrysmod).
